en: Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout; a `timeout` under 1 second now counts as 1 second
zh: 变更 prompt 和 agent hooks，使其每个 session 最多同时运行 24 个（含 sub-agents），外加最多 12 个等待时间超过其事件超时的 hook；小于 1 秒的 `timeout` 现在按 1 秒计
